'Rank' means position in the store's own best-selling sort.

occasions.diwali: Biggest gifting occasion. iTokri has 102 products in its diwali-gift-hampers collection, led by low-ticket assorted gift sets at 390-690. Zishta's return gifts are tagged 'Navratri and Diwali gift'. Amazon water-hyacinth trays are titled 'Deepawali'. GrassCrafts already has a 35-item Diwali hamper collection. Sources: https://www.itokri.com/collections/diwali-gift-hampers, https://www.zishta.com/collections/return-gifts
occasions.wedding_return_gifts: Nestasia's wedding-return-gifts collection (59 items) is mostly candle/tealight/snack-bowl sets of 2/4/6 at 600-2,200, with no grass baskets, which leaves an opening. Wholesale grass/jute baskets run 150-500 per piece at MOQ 20-100. Sources: https://nestasia.in/collections/wedding-return-gifts, https://www.indiamart.com/proddetail/assorted-sabai-handwoven-grass-basket-25457579355.html
occasions.puja_navratri: Madurkathi pooja aasans (350-600) rank in Zishta's mat top 10. Zishta also sells brass pooja basket sets of 5. Source: https://www.zishta.com/collections/natural-mats-chatai
occasions.housewarming: estimate: roti boxes, bread-basket sets, planters set of 2, and wall-plate sets are positioned as decor/kitchen gifts (basis: Brown Living and ICH best-seller mix; ICH sells sabai baskets pre-filled with towels as gift sets)
occasions.rakhi: Nestasia's rakhi-rakhi-hampers collection has 1,116 items and iTokri's rakhi-gift-hampers has 53, so hampers dominate this occasion. Basket-as-hamper-container is an inference. Source: https://www.itokri.com/collections/rakhi-gift-hampers
occasions.christmas_global: Etsy India and global markets show demand for empty wicker hamper baskets and bulk gift baskets, and Sirohi positions handwoven festive packaging. Sources: https://www.etsy.com/in-en/market/christmas_hamper, https://www.etsy.com/in-en/market/bulk_gift_basket
occasions.haldi_mehendi: GrassCrafts already has haldi/mehendi/wedding hamper collections (3-5 items each). Few competitors segment by ceremony (estimate: based on the collection lists scanned).

specs_patterns.sets: Sets of 2 are the dominant bundle for sabai (bread baskets, planters, storage, multi-purpose with handles). Sets of 3 appear for nesting kauna/jute/wall plates. Wall plates come in sets of 3/5/7. Coasters come in sets of 4/6 and table mats in sets of 6. Runner+mat sets come as 7.
specs_patterns.sizes: Planters are sold S/M/L/XL (Brown Living kauna) or 8in+10in pairs (Swadeh). Organisers run about 30x30x10 cm (Nestasia). Square boxes run 9x9 in (iTokri). Wall baskets run 8-12 in (Etsy) or 25/30 cm (wholesale). Madur floor mats come in 2x5, 3x5, 3x6 ft and 3-fold/4-fold variants. Amazon chatai mats run 4x6 ft and 6x3.5 ft. Letter holders measure 22x9 and 38x9 in.
specs_patterns.colours: Sabai sells on named colourways, such as Marigold Blaze, Turquoise Trail, Fuschia Flair and Prism Rim (Swadeh), and teal, mustard/royal blue and red & beige (ICH). Kauna and water hyacinth sell mostly as Natural, with red/green-natural accents. Madur mats sell in maroon, blue, black, haldi yellow, emerald, olive and chevron. The colours that sell out are bright sabai colourways (4 of 5 wall-plate colourways), blue/maroon madur, and green Nestasia boxes.
specs_patterns.materials_framing: Listings stress natural/eco-friendly, handwoven, artisan origin (Odisha/Mayurbhanj for sabai, Manipur for kauna, Assam for water hyacinth, Midnapore for madur), and iron frames for shape (Nestasia, Okhai Sirohi).
specs_patterns.sold_out_signals: Sold out: Brown Living sabai wall plates (set of 3: 4 of 5+ colourways; set of 5: 4 of 5), sabai organiser (2 of 4), Zishta madur large-floor-mat Large size and medium-mat colours, Okhai Kraftribe grass laundry basket, Nestasia green small planter and box, Zishta miniature brass pooja basket set of 5.

seasonality.diwali_hampers: Search interest starts rising in July and peaks in October (search snippet summarising Google Trends India). Inventory and ads should be ready by August.
seasonality.corporate_gift_hampers: Main peak in October, with secondary bumps in May, August and September (search snippet)
seasonality.return_gifts: 'indian festival return gifts' shows a concentrated surge in late November, which matches the wedding season (Nov-Feb) (search snippet)
seasonality.rakhi: Rakhi falls in August. Large hamper assortments at Nestasia (1,116 items) and iTokri suggest demand peaks in July-August (estimate: collection sizes)
seasonality.christmas_export: Etsy and global hamper/wall-basket demand peaks in Nov-Dec (estimate: Etsy Christmas hamper market pages; no trend data pulled)
seasonality.summer: estimate: madur/sitalpati sleeping mats sell more in Apr-Jun (basis: 'cooling mat' positioning; Amazon chatai mats show 200+ bought/month in October, which suggests year-round base demand)
seasonality.data_caveat: Google Trends could not be queried directly. These figures come from search-result summaries.

gaps_for_grasscrafts: Wall-plate SETS (3/5/7) in named bright colourways: Brown Living's top-5 seller is sold out in most colourways at INR 3,080-5,850. GrassCrafts' wall-art collection has only 11 items, so curated sets with clear diameters are an opening.

Bulk wedding/festive return-gift tier: competitors' return-gift collections are candles and brass, not grass baskets. Offer sabai/kauna mini baskets and boxes at INR 150-500 with MOQ 25/50/100, optional makhana fill, and custom tags.

Makhana-filled basket hampers: makhana is a mass best-seller on Amazon (20K+/month per brand), and GrassCrafts already has both makhana and baskets. Bundle 100-200 g packs in a sabai/kauna basket for Diwali, Rakhi and weddings.
Pack sizes buyers expect: sets of 2 (bread, planter, storage) and nesting sets of 3, plus S/M/L/XL planters. Put dimensions (cm/in) and set count in product titles, as iTokri and Zishta do.
Madurkathi: puja aasans (INR 350-600), 3-fold/4-fold sleeping mats, and runner+6-mat sets sell well. Offer 2x5/3x5/3x6 ft sizes and stock maroon, blue and black, which sell out at Zishta.
Kauna utility SKUs that rank at Okhai and Brown Living: waste-paper basket, lunch/picnic basket, tissue box, hut basket, laundry basket (INR 1,175-3,600).
Water hyacinth low-ticket entry items (coasters set of 6 at INR 550, pen holder at INR 600, trays at INR 1,190) top iTokri and Okhai, and work as add-ons and gifts.
Address the top complaints in the listing: sun-dry or de-odourise before dispatch and say so; show scale photos; use reinforced frames or rims; say plainly that colour varies.
Amazon/Flipkart presence: artisan sabai brands have few ratings there, and the review count is the gap. Seed ratings on 3-5 hero SKUs (roti box, planter set of 2, madur mat).
Export via Etsy: sabai wall-basket sets sell at USD 40+ and GBP 66+ with established shops (839 reviews). Christmas hamper baskets are a Nov-Dec export window.
Seasonal calendar: build Diwali stock in Jul-Aug for the October peak, return gifts for the Nov-Feb wedding season, Rakhi hampers in Jul-Aug, and mats in Apr-Jun (estimate).
